name: OpenObserve
tagline: Open-source observability for logs, metrics, traces and LLMs in one platform.
description: OpenObserve (O2) is a unified, open-source observability platform that ingests logs, metrics, traces and real-user monitoring with dashboards, alerts and session replay. It adds LLM observability, a natural-language query assistant and an SRE agent for automated incident correlation and root-cause analysis. It runs as a single self-hosted binary or Helm chart, or as fully managed OpenObserve Cloud.
insight: Open-source under AGPL-3.0; raised a $10M Series A in April 2026 (Nexus Venture Partners, Dell Technologies Capital); 18k+ GitHub stars.

modelSupport.notes: Infrastructure observability; LLM observability traces apps regardless of the underlying model.

edge: Claims ~140x lower storage cost than Elasticsearch via Parquet columnar storage, and unifies logs, metrics, traces, RUM and LLM observability in one binary.
pros: Single binary self-host or managed cloud
Logs, metrics, traces, RUM in one tool
cons: AGPL-3.0 can deter some commercial embedding

references.title: OpenObserve Raises $10 Million Series A to Accelerate AI-native Observability
